partnershipPlan: Two patient partners who had wound infections review the day-30 call script and the results summary.
socialListening: No social media listening; complaints mentioning wound problems from the last two years are read for themes.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The wound opened on day twelve at home and I did not know whether to ring the ward or my doctor.
items.implication: Keep the day-30 call and give a clear contact number at discharge.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If the form is one side of paper at the end of the case, we will do it; if it is two pages, we will not.
items.implication: Keep the form to one side and two minutes.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: At three in the morning with a perforation, nobody is checking the glucose.
items.implication: Report emergency compliance separately and look at which elements fail at night.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My father lives alone and never answers unknown numbers.
items.implication: Up to three call attempts and a clinic check for patients not reached.

summary: Four composite voices on post-discharge infection, the theatre form, emergency cases and hard-to-reach patients.
